SELECT COUNT(*) AS gold_member_count
FROM dim_member
WHERE tier = 'Gold' AND is_current = TRUE

SELECT tier, COUNT(*) AS member_count
FROM dim_member
WHERE is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY tier
ORDER BY member_count DESC

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS total_current,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN tier IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS null_tier_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31' THEN 1 END) AS valid_to_9999,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN is_current = TRUE AND valid_to != DATE '9999-12-31' THEN 1 END) AS current_but_not_9999
FROM dim_member
WHERE is_current = TRUE

SELECT COUNT(*) AS gold_tier_members
FROM dim_member
WHERE tier = 'Gold' AND is_current = TRUE
